rows.title: 9th International Conference on Prevention & Infection Control
rows.demandRationale: Scientific congress with 1,000+ healthcare professionals at the 2025 edition and an official housing bureau (MCI Suisse) that historically managed multi-hotel blocks; 2027 hotel list not yet published, so demand for this property is inferred, not confirmed.

fit.rationale: Secondary accommodation block or small ancillary meeting only — the main congress is committed to CICG in central Geneva and historic official hotels are city-centre. Founex needs a dedicated transfer plan; do not present as an easy congress base.

rows.fitForNonCentralGenevaEvent: Retained only as secondary/ancillary or future-cycle: the venue is central Geneva; YOTEL is outside the city and an airport-shuttle/transfer plan must be agreed before any proposal.

rows.title: 53rd EPS Conference on Plasma Physics (EPS Plasma 2027)
rows.venue: SwissTech Convention Center, EPFL campus, Ecublens (Lausanne area), Vaud
rows.demandRationale: Property-specific guestroom demand is unconfirmed in the research (no room block, hotel request, overflow shortage or YOTEL appointment); the conference is on the EPFL campus in the Lausanne area, outside the realistic daily-commute corridor.

fit.rationale: Pre/post-conference airport-corridor stopovers or a small delegation meeting are conceivable, but the venue is a stretch-territory location and no transfer-viable demand is evidenced.

rows.title: Hublot / LVMH — Nyon manufacture H3 commissioning and campus consolidation
rows.demandRationale: UNQUALIFIED in the research — no public evidence of a lodging programme, hotel block, recurring accommodation contract, temporary-assignee cohort or room-night requirement.

fit.rationale: Individual business stays and small training/project meetings are plausible for a Nyon manufacture campus 15 minutes away, but need are not evidenced.

rows.title: Château de Nyon / Caveau de Nyon — corporate and private-event referral route
rows.venue: Château de Nyon / Caveau de Nyon, Nyon, Vaud
rows.demandRationale: Conditional, referral-led prospect — the research states it is not a proven room-block account and overnight demand from private-function guests is unverified.

fit.rationale: A referral/partnership route (corporate groups combining hotel meetings with an off-site wine evening) — not hotel-demand evidence.

rows.title: 2026 FISU World University Championship Triathlon (Nyon)

fit.rationale: Post-event supplier conversation for future local triathlon editions only.

fit.rationale: Low fit for relocating the gala; attendance (400+) exceeds YOTEL's single-room capacity.
